title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Love and Hate
Prison is a lonely place for any inmate; relationships that existed on the outside become strained and the ones that blossom within the prison walls are often dangerous; or they can be simply a one-sided obsession, leading to nothing but trouble.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Thicker Than a Bowl of Oatmeal
A gang leader has his authority challenged by another inmate, but questions arise over whether the challenger is who he says he is; in the women's wing, one inmate's personality divides her housing unit; before long, verbal altercations turn violent.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Highs and Lows
The Emergency Response Team have their hands full of a sadistic murderer who transforms the jail, a roller derby queen who takes a hard fall and one inmate who realizes that even a good day in jail can have a dark side.

title: Lockup: Fairfax: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Time Never Waits
The Emergency Response Team is deployed when a mentally ill inmate soils his cell and refuses orders; a vicious assault sends another inmate to the hospital; a fresh face joins the female unit, and finds herself in the middle of an investigation.

title: Lockup: Fairfax: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Solitary
A new inmate struggles with life on the tough side of the jail; another inmate is offered a chance to improve his condition but mounts a defense anyway; a female inmate requires some special attention from staff members.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Old School, New School
Gang violence breaks out when a long-simmering feud boils over; caught in the middle of the conflict is a young inmate, and jail staff responds with an all-out search for weapons.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Red and Whites
A group of prisoners are entrusted with potential weapons, but for the benefit of others; one of them hopes this assignment will result in a life-long bond; back at the jail, an inmate brawl leaves several officers injured.

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Outlaws and In-Laws
Five miles from the riverfront hotels and restaurants of Savannah, Georgia, is a more ominous site, a place where an inmate is severely injured, and a friendship is torn; two soon to be brothers-in-law are accused of double homicide.

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Wis-Dumb
A planned romantic weekend turns into a nightmare for one young couple; a fight sends two women to segregation, and for one of the combatants, the isolation takes its toll.
